message.content: The magazine cover features a stark white background with a vertical red band along the left edge and a horizontal one at the bottom. A large, red, serif-font title "TEMPO" dominates the top. Above it is the black text "KILAS BALIK 2017," and below it is the smaller black text "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." A central graphic element shows a faint, grey skull shape formed from smoke or vapor, which appears to be rising from the open mouth of a clear plastic water bottle. The bottle is filled with a colorless liquid and is covered in condensation droplets. Its blue-tinged neck and open top are positioned in the center, directly under the skull. Large black text across the center reads "AWAS AIR NERAKA." Below this, a smaller paragraph of black text reads "Badan Narkotika Nasional menggerebek diskotek pembuat narkoba cair. Benarkah pabrik laknat itu bertahun-tahun dibiarkan?". At the bottom left, there is a barcode with numbers, and next to it, black text providing the date "25-31 DESEMBER 2017," price "RP 45.000," website, and magazine type.
